quiz_title: Web Design - Quiz 5: Typography & Advanced Layout

questions.q: Which typography property controls reading directions like right-to-left for Arabic?
questions.exp: direction: rtl; aligns reading structures from right-to-left, which is required for Arabic fonts!

questions.q: What happens when you set text-transform to capitalize?
opts: The first letter of every word becomes uppercase
questions.exp: capitalize changes the first letter of each word to uppercase, while uppercase changes all letters!

questions.q: Which property aligns elements left/right of their container and allows text wrapping?
questions.exp: float allows elements (like images) to hug borders, letting textual paragraphs wrap smoothly around them!

questions.q: Which overflow value adds scrollbars to a box ONLY when content exceeds size bounds?
questions.exp: overflow: auto; is smart! It only shows scrollbars if the text is too large to fit in the box.

questions.q: Which pseudo-class styles a hyperlink when the user's cursor hovering over it?
questions.exp: a:hover activates styling rules the instant a student hovers their cursor over link buttons!
